Happy upcoming holidays!
And don't forget about cats:)

notes.title: "Roman Wars:" Demo
notes.content: Hi everyone. We are a small indie team and we have just recently uploaded Demo of our first game on Steam. The Demo includes first two missions of the game, two Bonus Cards, and the tutorial. Enjoy the Demo and feel free to give us feedback! Thanks in advance!
